description: This file defines a React hook 'useProgressiveExpand' and a utility function 'createProgressiveExpandController' for managing batch processing with UI progress updates, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand
